- `internal/systemd/service_test.go` — 6 tests covering unit file structure, GITHUB_TOKEN inclusion/exclusion, DataDir cleaning, custom StacksDir
- `cmd/install.go` — `herald install [--user] [--start] [--enable]`: checks root, validates user exists, warns if not in docker group, writes service, enables/starts per flags, prints status summary
